query:
MATCH p = ALL ACYCLIC (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(t:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses documented ALL ACYCLIC path matching and postfix 1-to-3-hop quantifier. transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) preserves path node order and returns business IDs. RETURN has no DISTINCT, preserving rows from parallel-edge paths. Checked against the current query skill and relevant references; not executed against a database.
